scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:google-auth && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:data-transfer && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:session-cookie && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:prices && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:sources && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:migrations
